comments.text: I know I'm late to the party, but what is between the legs of the lions in the version of the coat of arms at 3:52?  Thumbs up, or meat and potatoes(vlees en aardappelen)?  They do seem happy to be there. I will be too, during my visit on 👑🇳🇱Koningsdag 2027!
